description: Mint a shareable URL for a completed study, audit or creative comparison so someone without an Aetherya account can read the findings. Use it after aetherya_get_brief when the user wants to send the results to a colleague or client, or post them. The link is PUBLIC to anyone who has it. A study shared without options gets its public link plus a preview card for posting; pass expires_in or a password for a private, expiring link instead.

expires_in.description: How long the link stays live. Audits and comparisons default to 30d. A study with no expiry and no password gets its public link (stays live until the owner stops sharing it).

id.description: The run id for a study, the reportId (not the job_id) for an audit, or the comparison id.

kind.description: 'study' for a research run id, 'audit' for an audit report id, 'creative_comparison' for a compare_creatives comparison id.

password.description: Optional password required to open the link. Never returned in the response.

name: aetherya_share_result
title: Create a public link to a finished run's findings
